title: Accessibility Best Practices for Web Developers
author: Samyak Jain
excerpt: Learn how to make your websites accessible to everyone, including users with disabilities, by following WCAG guidelines and best practices.
content:
Web accessibility ensures that websites are usable by everyone, including people with disabilities. It's not just the right thing to do—it's often required by law. ## Semantic HTML Use semantic HTML elements: ```html

Accessibility benefits everyone, not just users with disabilities.
